claim: For a Scan, DynamoDB calculates the read capacity units consumed based on the number of items and the size of those items, not on the amount of data that is returned to an application, so the capacity consumed is the same whether you request all attributes or use a projection expression, and whether or not you use a filter expression.
question: Does a Scan consume read capacity for the items it reads or for the data it returns?

evidence.quote: DynamoDB calculates the number of read capacity units consumed based on the number of items and the size of those items, not on the amount of data that is returned to an application.
For this reason, the number of capacity units consumed is the same whether you request all of the attributes (the default behavior) or just some of them (using a projection expression).
The number is also the same whether or not you use a filter expression.
